description: This source file defines the ShoppingCartFacade interface, which provides an abstraction layer for shopping cart operations in a web shop application, hiding the core model from controllers and exposing data transfer objects.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacade
classes.description: Interface providing methods for shopping cart management, including adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting shopping cart data.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart, returning updated shopping cart data.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new shopping cart model based on shopping cart code, store, and customer.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data for a customer and store, optionally by cart ID or code.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart by item ID and cart ID.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific item in the cart.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes the entire shopping cart by ID or code for a given store.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple shopping cart items at once.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart model for a customer or by cart code.
